import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--out', required=True)
p.add_argument('--cwd', required=True)
p.add_argument('--bin-dir', required=True)
p.add_argument('--mode', default='offline-synthetic')
p.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
a = p.parse_args()
command = a.command[1:] if a.command[:1] == ['--'] else a.command
if not command:
    p.error('command required')
out = Path(a.out).resolve()
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
cwd = Path(a.cwd).resolve()
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path(a.bin_dir).resolve()) + os.pathsep + env.get('PATH', '')
# Preserve managed preloads; suppress only the known optional proxy-agent warning.
env['NODE_OPTIONS'] = (env.get('NODE_OPTIONS', '') + ' --disable-warning=UNDICI-EHPA').strip()

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def read_git(argv):
    r = subprocess.run(['git', *argv], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError('git inspection failed: ' + repr(argv))
    return r.stdout.decode().strip()

pins = {'head': read_git(['rev-parse', 'HEAD']), 'tree': read_git(['rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}']),
        'status': read_git(['status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all'])}
changed = read_git(['diff', '--name-only']).splitlines()
pins['changed_files'] = [{ 'path': name, 'sha256': sha((cwd / name).read_bytes()) } for name in changed if (cwd/name).is_file()]
node = Path(a.bin_dir).resolve() / 'node'
runtime = subprocess.run([str(node), '--version'], capture_output=True, env=env)
if runtime.returncode:
    raise RuntimeError('node version inspection failed')
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
r = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True)
finished = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
(out/'stdout.log').write_bytes(r.stdout)
(out/'stderr.log').write_bytes(r.stderr)
record = {'command': command, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'mode': a.mode,
          'started_at': started, 'finished_at': finished, 'exit_code': r.returncode,
          'source': pins, 'node': {'path': str(node), 'version': runtime.stdout.decode().strip(), 'sha256': sha(node.read_bytes())},
          'managed_node_options_preserved': True, 'added_node_option': '--disable-warning=UNDICI-EHPA',
          'stdout': {'path':'stdout.log','bytes':len(r.stdout),'sha256':sha(r.stdout)},
          'stderr': {'path':'stderr.log','bytes':len(r.stderr),'sha256':sha(r.stderr)}}
(out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'out':str(out),'exit_code':r.returncode,'node':record['node']['version'],
                  'head':pins['head'],'changed_files':pins['changed_files'],
                  'stdout_tail':r.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[-7000:],
                  'stderr_tail':r.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[-2500:]},indent=2))
sys.exit(r.returncode)
